Brazil Presidential Election Features Tight Race and AI Concerns

Brazil's presidential election is underway with incumbent left-wing President Lula da Silva and former President Jair Bolsonaro's son, Flavio Bolsonaro, in a near-tie according to polls. The tight race is being closely watched for its potential impact on a regional rightward political shift. Concerns have also emerged regarding the influence of artificial intelligence, including deepfake avatars and AI-generated content, on the election campaign.
